title: Thai-Style Bean and Sprout Tacos
description: A fusion of Thai and Mexican flavors in a crunchy taco shell. This dish is low in calories and rich in protein and fiber.
instructions: 1. Preheat a dry skillet or grill over medium-high heat.
2. Cook the taco shells according to package instructions.
3. In a large bowl, combine the mung bean sprouts, black beans, and zesty Mexican seasoning.
4. Spoon the bean and sprout mixture into the cooked taco shells.
5. Top with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice, if desired.
